SYMPTOM: Full-photo UUID upload failed silently — logs showed '[ImageSearch:full] Error' with onetrust-consent-sdk blocking clicks

CAUSE: warmUpVinted dismisses cookie banner on first page load, but navigating to the upload page triggered a fresh consent overlay. The JS evaluate() removal at 500ms ran but overlay re-rendered.

FIX: In upload flow, after navigating to page:
1. page.evaluate() to remove onetrust overlay from DOM
2. Click the accept button via selector if visible
3. Force-click the image search button (bypasses overlay interception)

LOCATION: playwright-service in Docker microservice (port 3002)

NOTE: Cookie acceptance persists within the Playwright browser session, so subsequent uploads in the same session don't re-trigger.
